access.ro: Pentru a accesa Oued Ed-Dahab, vizitatorii folosesc de obicei cărări de pământ de la șoseaua principală. Un șofer local de încredere e foarte recomandat.
access.en: To access Oued Ed-Dahab, you typically use regional roads or dirt paths branching from main routes. Hiring a reliable local driver is highly recommended.

terrain.ro: Peisajul la Oued Ed-Dahab are de obicei teren denivelat, stâncos ce cere o navigare mereu atentă. Potecile sunt adesea complet nemarcate pe traseul principal.
terrain.en: The landscape of Oued Ed-Dahab features uneven, rocky ground and sandy banks needing careful walking. Paths are quite often unmarked, requiring balance.

gear.en: Essential gear for Oued Ed-Dahab includes closed-toe walking shoes for rough terrain, plus sun protection. Always bring plenty of extra drinking water.

parking.en: Parking near Oued Ed-Dahab generally involves leaving your vehicle at informal dirt spots or rural villages. Always secure belongings and check spot safety.

safety.ro: La Oued Ed-Dahab, fiți precauți la schimbările de nivel al apei și malurile instabile care prezintă riscuri majore. Zona este izolată, așa că fiți foarte alert mereu.
safety.en: At Oued Ed-Dahab, be cautious of sudden water changes and unstable banks posing slipping hazards. The area is extremely remote, so stay highly alert.

duration.en: A typical visit to Oued Ed-Dahab takes one to three full hours, depending on your planned walking pace. Include local travel time and dedicate at least a half-day.
